JavaScript is off in this browser, so TiddlyInstall can't build or sign installers here; the pages still read. Turn JavaScript on for this page, or open it in a current browser. (Internet Explorer on Windows Server keeps JavaScript off while its Enhanced Security Configuration is on.)
Real installers for Windows, Linux and macOS, straight from a GitHub repo. No freezing and no bundlers that break. We install your project's real runtime and dependencies into a folder of its own, clone your project, and install it against them. The result is an ordinary installer built with NSIS on Windows and the Qt Installer Framework on Linux and macOS. Make an installerWrite an appStart from a base installer One file, like TiddlyWiki TiddlyInstall is a single HTML file. This page carries the base installers, the runtime catalogue and all the code that makes, edits and signs installers. Save it (at the bottom of the page) and open it from your disk,
